home.heroSubtitle: TOLOM powers every part of your workshop — work orders, inventory, customer relationships, mechanic tracking, and finances. All in one place, built for tablets.
home.trustTitle: Trusted by auto service businesses across Mongolia
home.featuresTitle: Everything You Need to Run Your Shop
home.featuresSubtitle: From check-in to checkout, TOLOM covers every step of the service workflow.
home.featureWorkOrdersDesc: Create, track, and manage work orders from a tablet-optimized interface. Assign mechanics, track labor, and manage parts seamlessly.
home.featureInventoryDesc: Track parts and supplies with a ledger-based system. Never lose inventory again with real-time stock levels and movement history.
home.featureCustomersDesc: Complete customer profiles with vehicle history, service records, and preferences. Know every car that comes through your door.
home.featurePricingDesc: Store service prices, labor rates, and parts costs. No more guessing or inconsistent quotes — your entire catalog at your fingertips.
home.featureReportsDesc: Daily, weekly, and monthly productivity reports per mechanic. Know who's performing and where there's room for improvement.
home.featureAnalyticsDesc: Real-time KPIs, revenue tracking, and business insights. Make data-driven decisions with beautiful, understandable charts.
home.featureMultiBranchDesc: Manage multiple locations from a single dashboard. Compare performance, consolidate reporting, and keep your brand consistent.

home.howItWorksSubtitle: Get your shop running on TOLOM in three simple steps.
home.step1Desc: Customer arrives. Look up their vehicle, create a work order, and describe the issue — all from a tablet in under 30 seconds.
home.step2Desc: Assign mechanics, track labor hours, add parts from inventory, and update status in real time. Everyone knows what's happening.
home.step3Desc: Generate invoice, process payment, and send a digital receipt. Schedule follow-up and send automated reminders.
home.workflowTitle: One system for the front desk, the workshop, and the owner
home.workflowSubtitle: Most software handles only one slice of the operation. TOLOM connects the full service cycle so handoffs stop falling through the cracks.
home.workflowBody: That means the advisor can check a vehicle in fast, the mechanic can keep work moving without paper back-and-forth, and the owner can see what is profitable without waiting for end-of-day summaries.
home.workflowFrontDeskTitle: Front desk stays fast and consistent
home.workflowFrontDeskDesc: Give advisors a clear flow for intake, quotes, approvals, and customer communication.
home.workflowFrontDeskPoint1: Search customers and vehicles instantly by phone number, plate, or name.
home.workflowFrontDeskPoint2: Build work orders with services, parts, notes, and status updates in one screen.
home.workflowFrontDeskPoint3: Keep every promise and next step visible so customers are never left guessing.
home.workflowWorkshopTitle: Technicians stay focused on the repair
home.workflowWorkshopDesc: Keep the workshop aligned without chasing people for updates or rewriting the same information twice.
home.workflowWorkshopPoint1: Assign work clearly so every bay, mechanic, and vehicle has visible ownership.
home.workflowWorkshopPoint2: Track labor, parts usage, and repair progress while the job is still in motion.
home.workflowWorkshopPoint3: Capture a clean service history that helps the next visit start with context.
home.workflowManagementDesc: See where revenue, delays, and inventory pressure are building before they become expensive.
home.workflowManagementPoint1: Monitor KPIs, mechanic performance, and active work without waiting for reports.
home.workflowManagementPoint2: Compare locations, teams, and service categories from one shared operating view.
home.workflowManagementPoint3: Use real numbers for staffing, pricing, and purchasing decisions instead of guesswork.
home.differenceTitle: TOLOM is built for the way Mongolian auto service actually runs
home.differenceSubtitle: It is not generic small-business software with a garage label on top. The product is shaped around the messy, fast-moving reality of service bays, repeat vehicles, inconsistent pricing, and growing teams.
home.differenceTabletDesc: The interface is designed for the counter and the shop floor, so teams can update jobs in the moment instead of writing notes to enter later.
home.differencePricingDesc: TOLOM remembers recent prices for the same service and vehicle context, helping your team give faster, more consistent estimates and protect margin.
home.differenceVisibilityTitle: Every customer and vehicle keeps its story
home.differenceVisibilityDesc: From first visit to repeat repair, your team can see history, notes, prior parts, and recommendations without digging through chat threads or paper folders.
home.differenceScalabilityTitle: Ready for one branch or several
home.differenceScalabilityDesc: Start with a single workshop and expand without changing systems. Branch structure, permissions, and reporting are already part of the foundation.
home.testimonial1: TOLOM transformed how we run our shop. Work orders that used to take 10 minutes now take 30 seconds. Our customers love the SMS reminders.
home.testimonial2: The multi-branch dashboard alone saved us hours every week. We can finally see how all our locations are performing in real time.

faq.metaDescription: Answers to the most frequently asked questions about TOLOM. Topics include registration, work orders, inventory, finance, service reminders, and more.
faq.pageDescription: Find answers to the most common questions about TOLOM.
faq.a1: TOLOM is a comprehensive management system (Auto Repair Operating System / ERP) for auto service businesses. Manage work orders, customer records, inventory, financial reports, service reminders, and mechanic performance — all in one place.
faq.q2: What devices does TOLOM work on?
faq.a2: TOLOM works on all devices — tablets, smartphones, and computers. The interface is especially optimized for tablets, making it ideal for front desk and garage use.
faq.a3: Click 'Sign Up' on the login page, then enter your organization name, full name, email address, and password. After registration, your organization, main branch, and admin/mechanic roles are created automatically, and a 14-day free trial is activated.
faq.a4: Yes. All plans come with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required. You can explore all Pro features during the trial period.
faq.q5: How do I change the language?
faq.a5: Use the 'MN' / 'EN' toggle at the top of the system to switch languages instantly. Mongolian and English are supported.
faq.q6: What are the work order statuses?
faq.a6: Six statuses: New (blue) → Diagnosing (yellow) → In Progress (orange) → Ready for Pickup (green) → Completed (gray), and Cancelled (red). Each status change is recorded in the order history as an immutable ledger and cannot be undone.
faq.a7: Every time a service or part is used in a work order, its price is automatically saved. The next time the same service is performed on the same vehicle, the last 3 prices are shown and the most recent price is suggested by default. This reduces pricing inconsistency.
faq.a8: When a returning customer brings in their vehicle, you can quickly add services and parts from their previous work order using checkboxes. This speeds up repeat service registration.
faq.q9: How do I register a customer?
faq.a9: Go to 'Customers' and click 'New Customer'. Select type (individual or organization), enter name, phone number, email, and address. Searching by phone number is the fastest method — just type a few digits and matching customers appear.
faq.q10: How do I register a vehicle?
faq.a10: Go to 'Vehicles' and click 'New Vehicle'. Enter the license plate, make, model, year, VIN, color, engine, fuel type, and other details. A vehicle can be linked to multiple owners. The system auto-suggests registered vehicles when creating work orders.
faq.a11: Each vehicle's detail page shows all past work orders, last visit date, and odometer reading changes.
faq.a12: You can add notes on each customer's detail page. Note types include: General, Follow Up, Complaint, Call, Email, Meeting, and Other. All notes track who created and last modified them.
faq.a13: Inventory balances are tracked using an immutable ledger. You cannot directly edit a quantity — you must add a movement with the correct type. Movement types include: purchase, sale, adjustment, transfer_in, transfer_out, return, and waste.
faq.q14: What do the color indicators mean?
faq.a14:
Inventory level colors:
• Green 🟢 — Sufficient stock (above threshold)
• Yellow 🟡 — Running low (near threshold)
• Red 🔴 — Very low (below threshold, needs urgent reorder)
faq.a15: Purchase orders (PO) have 5 statuses: Draft → Ordered → Partial → Received → Cancelled. When items are received, the system automatically increases inventory balances with a 'purchase' type movement.
faq.a16: The finance section has 3 tabs: Overview (total revenue, average order value, charts), Transactions (all transaction history), and Invoices (create, send, and share invoices). Filterable by Today / This Week / This Month / All Time.
faq.a17: 4 currencies are supported: Mongolian Tugrik (MNT, ₮), US Dollar (USD, $), Euro (EUR, €), and Chinese Yuan (CNY, ¥). You can change the currency in Settings.
faq.q18: How do I send an invoice?
faq.a18: Find the invoice in the list and click the Email button. The system sends the invoice to the customer's email address. Each invoice also has a public link — customers can view, print, and download without logging in.
faq.q19: How do I manage expense categories?
faq.a19: The system comes with 10 default categories (Rent & Utilities, Salaries, Parts & Supplies, etc.). You can add new categories and customize names, colors, and icons. Expenses can be grouped by category for reporting.
faq.a20: Create a schedule by vehicle, service, and frequency. The system calculates the next due date based on the last service date and interval. Due dates are color-coded: green (not due), yellow (due within 7 days), red (overdue).
faq.a21: The Sync History button scans previous work orders, detects services performed, and automatically creates schedules using catalog default intervals. This lets you set up many vehicle schedules in one click without manual entry.
faq.q22: How do I set up a PIN code?
faq.a22: Go to Settings and find 'Bay View PIN'. Enter a 4-6 digit PIN to protect the Bay View page from unauthorized access. It's recommended to change the PIN regularly.
faq.a23: Yes. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. We use Supabase RLS (Row Level Security) policies ensuring tenant isolation — Organization A can never see Organization B's data. Automated database backups with point-in-time recovery are performed regularly.
faq.a24: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades apply at the next billing cycle.
faq.a25: Yes. REST API access is included in the Business plan. You can connect your own systems, website, or applications to TOLOM.
faq.q26: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a26: We accept bank transfers and credit cards. For annual plans, we offer a discount equivalent to 2 months free.
faq.q27: Do you offer onboarding and training?
faq.a27: Yes. All plans include basic onboarding. Pro and Business plans include staff training and data migration assistance. Enterprise plans include dedicated onboarding.

about.metaDescription: TOLOM is an operating system for auto service businesses in Mongolia. Learn about our team, mission, and vision.
about.pageDescription: Learn about the team, mission, and vision behind TOLOM.
about.storyBody1: TOLOM was founded to solve real problems that Mongolian auto service businesses face every day. For years, we watched garage owners manage work orders, inventory, and finances on paper — losing customer records, struggling with pricing inconsistency, and missing revenue opportunities.
about.storyBody2: We set out to build a system that is easy to use, feature-rich, and affordable. Today, TOLOM helps Mongolian auto service businesses manage work orders, customer relationships, inventory, financial reports, and service reminders — all in one place.
about.missionBody: To digitize Mongolian auto service businesses, making their operations more efficient, transparent, and profitable.
about.visionBody: To become the Auto Repair Operating System for Mongolia, then expand into regional SaaS, parts marketplace, fleet management, payments, and data layers.
about.approachBody1:
• Tablet-first interface designed for front desk and mechanic workflows
• Pricing memory — solving Mongolia's real-world pricing inconsistency
• Immutable ledger — transparent financial and inventory tracking
• Multi-tenant architecture — isolated environments for each organization
• RLS security — data isolation and encryption at every layer
about.value1Desc: Easy to use for both garage owners and mechanics
about.value2Desc: Every action recorded in immutable ledgers — who did what, when
about.value3Desc: Built for Mongolia's real conditions — works when you need it
about.value4Desc: From a single garage to multi-branch enterprises
about.techBody: TOLOM is built on modern stack: Next.js, Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage), and Vercel. Data is isolated per-organization via RLS policies and encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest.
about.ctaSubtitle: 14-day free trial. No credit card required.
